citation: Browaeys R, Saelens W, Saeys Y. NicheNet: modeling intercellular communication by linking ligands to target genes. Nature Methods (2020).
transformation_log: Read the named 33354 target by 1226 ligand matrix without rescaling.
For each ligand, retained the 250 targets with the largest positive regulatory-potential weights.
Discarded zero-weight links and sorted deterministically by ligand, rank, and target.
Stored weights as float32 and rank as int16 in Zstandard-compressed Parquet.
